# Ari Leal

> Integrative coaching with Ari Leal for people in transition: life direction, psychedelic preparation and integration, and relationships. Ari Leal, LLC. Sessions by video across the United States; based in St. Petersburg, Florida. Coaching, not therapy. Free 15-minute first conversation.

Scope, stated plainly: Ari Leal, LLC offers coaching and educational services only. It is not psychotherapy, medical care, or mental-health treatment, and no offering provides, encourages, or sources controlled substances. Ari Leal's psychotherapy practice is a separate business, Therapy Glow (https://therapyglow.com), where he practices as a Florida Registered Mental Health Counselor Intern, in Florida only. Therapy questions belong there; coaching questions belong here.

## The work

- [Coaching](https://www.arileal.com/coaching.html): One-to-one coaching for people at a turning point in work, a relationship, or what life means.
- [Integration](https://www.arileal.com/integration.html): Coaching for the season around a ceremony: preparing before, and making sense of it after.
- [Match Checking](https://www.arileal.com/match-checking.html): A structured read on whether two people fit, plus ongoing coaching for couples who want to protect and deepen what they have. Not couples therapy.

## Tools and writing

- [The Library](https://www.arileal.com/library.html): Evergreen guides on psychedelic integration, coaching, assessment, compatibility, the body and the esoteric traditions.
- [Psychedelic Drug Development in 2026](https://www.arileal.com/article-pharmacology-revolution.html): FDA final guidance, Phase 3 psilocybin, and what the pharmacology boom means for the person doing integration work.
- [The Holding Map](https://www.arileal.com/holding-map.html): A free instrument for locating where an unusual or spiritual experience sits in a life: what it costs, how much room it takes, how alone you are in it. Not whether it was real, and not a diagnosis.
- [Same Side of the Table](https://www.arileal.com/same-side.html): A free guided decision tool for couples who run a business together.

## Also

- [UNFOLD](https://www.arileal.com/unfold.html): Objects for the inner life, beginning with a psychedelic microdosing integration journal.
- [For Clinicians](https://clinicians.arileal.com/): Services for therapists and practices: forms, Spanish materials, grant writing, manuals and apps, tools, and creative.
